summary: Principal Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior notes due 2037, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by its subsidiary Principal Financial Services Inc. The terms—aggregate principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date—are left blank as placeholders. The notes are senior unsecured, not listed on any exchange, and subject to optional redemption. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, restructuring) is present; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
